base: Create a full-body 3D character render of the child from the reference photos, in the style of a modern Pixar / Disney animated film: big expressive eyes, soft subsurface-scattered skin, detailed stylized hair, chibi proportions (head about one third of body height), warm cinematic lighting, high detail, 8k render look. Keep the child's real likeness: face shape, skin tone, eye color, hair color and hairstyle, glasses or freckles if present. Friendly happy expression, age-appropriate and wholesome. Full body visible from head to feet, standing, facing the camera, arms relaxed, centered, with some empty space around the character. Plain smooth light background in a single soft color ({bg}), no text, no logo, no other people. Costume and theme: {costume}
companion: A small matching cute animal companion ({pet}) sits next to the character's feet.

motions.idle: The character stands in place, breathing gently, blinking, and slightly swaying with a soft smile. The camera is completely static. Plain background stays unchanged. Seamless loop.
motions.cheer: The character jumps up with joy, raises both arms and cheers happily, then lands in the same spot. The camera is completely static. Plain background stays unchanged.
motions.oops: The character makes a cute, gentle 'oops' face, shrugs and scratches the head, then smiles again encouragingly. The camera is completely static. Plain background stays unchanged.
motions.dance: The character does a short happy victory dance in place, spinning once and waving. The camera is completely static. Plain background stays unchanged.
